Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sculpted updo balayage hair — full body glowing violet nebula starfield fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid starfield body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a deep cosmos of swirling luminous gas clouds and dust lanes in rich overlapping layers, thousands of tiny bright stars embedded across every curve, a few large brilliant stars with soft cross-shaped glints, thin glowing constellation lines linking the brightest stars across her torso and legs, glowing softly from within, nothing lying flat. Dense cosmic surface — BLAZING deep indigo-violet and magenta nebula clouds across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID tiny white and gold stars and thin gold constellation lines linking the brightest stars, softly glowing, completely opaque, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

Background: a bright modern bus terminal with a clean pale concrete floor, a glass canopy, standard-height bus doors and a bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
